name: Subtraktion
description: Ripple-Borrow-Subtrahierer: c=(a-b) modulo 2^n; borrow=1 genau bei a<b. Feste Subtrahierstufen; unsigned Eingänge.
source:
def subtract<w>(a, b):
    x = bits(a, w)
    y = bits(b, w)
    result = [0] * (w + 1)
    borrow = 0
    for i in range(w):
        parity = x[i] ^ y[i]
        result[i] = parity ^ borrow
        borrow = ((1 ^ x[i]) & y[i]) | ((1 ^ parity) & borrow)
    result[w] = borrow
    return pack(result)

difference = bits(subtract<n>(a, b), n + 1)
return pack(difference[:n]), difference[n]
